newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Republic Ratings upgrades Premier.
newsitem.headline: Republic Ratings upgrades Premier.

text.p: Republic Ratings on Monday upgraded industrial holdings group Premier Ltd's long term rating from an A to A+, defined as an organisation with a strong capacity to honour its debt obligations in a timely fashion.
Republic Ratings director Dave King said in a statement the rating upgrade was deemed warranted on the basis of the considerable strengthening of Premier's financial structure over the past year.

"Due to a combination of asset disposals, improved internal cash flows and a rights issue, core borrowings of the company and its wholly owned subsidiaries have been reduced to around 270 million rand from 1.35 billion rand at the April 1995 year end," King said.
In addition, corrective measures -- implemented at Premier Foods and United Pharmaceutical Holdings -- were expected to improve margins in the current year.
